name: Free Dharma Darshanam (Gaddelu)
timing: During Jathara: Open 24/7; Non-Jathara Days: 6:00 AM to 8:00 PM
description: Entry and Darshan at Medaram Gaddelu are completely free for all pilgrims. No online tickets are required.

name: Special VIP / Protocol Entry (During Jathara)
description: Special Protocol VIP Passes managed by District Administration.

name: Bangaram Tulabharam (Jaggery Offering)
price: Based on Jaggery Weight (Purchased from local counters ₹40–50/kg)
description: Offering Jaggery (Bangaram) equal to the devotee's body weight to Sammakka and Saralamma Ammavarlu.

name: Kesha Khandanam (Hair Tonsure at Kalyana Katta)
description: Tonsure/hair offering at Kalyana Katta near Jampanna Vagu.
